text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 100,000 Tunisian families have benefited from a programme to help the poor sponsored by President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali.
- President Ben Ali receives the head of the state accounting court, recommends the best use of state money.
- The 9th development plan (1997-2001) aims at annual GDP growth of 6.2 percent.
- Transport Minister Sadok Rabeh to visit Baghdad.
